picks.title: Workflow Lab: deploying designs directly with Figma Make
picks.excerpt: Figma walks through a workflow where designers connect a production codebase to Figma Make, implement accessibility and polish refinements themselves, and open a pull request — collapsing the traditional design-to-engineering handoff.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the pool: a first-party, step-by-step workflow a designer can run tomorrow to ship a PR without a handoff.

picks.title: SideFX just released Houdini 22
picks.excerpt: SideFX shipped Houdini 22 with a full 3D Gaussian Splatting toolset — including training splats from real-world reference photos — plus KineFX rigging and Copernicus image-processing upgrades.
picks.rationale: Major shipped release, not commentary: a full Gaussian Splatting toolset lands in a mainstream 3D DCC and changes what reference photos are good for.

picks.title: Design tokens in 2026: Figma Variables vs Tokens Studio
picks.excerpt: With the W3C DTCG token format stabilized, Figma Variables and Tokens Studio both export compliant JSON — ending tool lock-in and shifting the choice to actual theming complexity rather than format compatibility.
picks.rationale: Concrete tooling decision with a real hinge — DTCG stabilizing removes lock-in, so token teams can pick on theming needs alone.

picks.title: OpenAI launches a physical keypad for controlling agents
picks.excerpt: OpenAI and Work Louder shipped the $230 Codex Micro, a physical keypad with programmable keys, LED status lights and a reasoning-level dial — an early attempt at hardware interaction design for agentic work.
picks.rationale: Back-fill for the cross-section SmartRoto conflict: a shipped product rather than a think-piece, and the most novel item left — a physical control surface for agents makes the section's AX thesis tangible.

picks.title: From vibe to specs: reclaiming the design process with the SAID framework
picks.excerpt: A proposed SAID framework pushes back on vibe-coding drift by reclaiming specs as the designer's leverage point, turning loose AI prompting into a structured, reviewable design process.
picks.rationale: A named, reusable framework rather than another AI-anxiety essay — gives designers a concrete way to reclaim specs from vibe-coding drift.
